functions.name: mnr_print
functions.description: Prints information related to the MNR library or environment. Exact output, destination stream, and formatting are not documented in the header. Typical usage is to call this function to emit a banner or diagnostic text; it takes no arguments and returns no value.

functions.name: mnr_repo
functions.description: Returns a const, null-terminated C string identifying the MNR repository (e.g., a name, path, or URL). The exact content, ownership, and lifetime of the returned pointer are not documented in the header.
requirements: The returned pointer must be treated as read-only (const-qualified string).
Ownership and lifetime of the returned pointer are unknown; do not assume it can be freed or that it remains valid beyond immediate use without additional documentation.
